name: oshan-mendis-ict
description: A bilingual React/Vite and Express/MongoDB learning platform for A/L ICT students. Student registration, admin management, batch enrollments, manual payment verification, protected PDF downloads, class schedules, announcements, and learning progress use the same MongoDB records.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
